title: PEM-encoded private key: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: Synthetic PEM-encoded private key values built to the documented format appear in 18 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Legacy PEM bodies decode to public prose, not key material. Only the locally parseable Ed25519 PKCS#8 control is a positive.
